mapper.select: SELECT aol.ID, aol.ARTICLE_ID, aol.OPERATION_TYPE, aol.OPERATOR_ID, u.NICKNAME AS operatorUserNickname, aol.BEFORE_TYPE, aol.AFTER_TYPE, aol.BEFORE_PERM, aol.AFTER_PERM, aol.BEFORE_STATUS, aol.AFTER_STATUS, aol.VERSION, aol.REMARK, aol.CREATE_TIME FROM article_operation_log aol LEFT JOIN user u ON aol.OPERATOR_ID = u.ID WHERE aol.ARTICLE_ID = #{query.articleId}
